old_material_rechecked.finding: Pulse units, inline C, O approximate sign and a piacere/in tempo recovery retained; local scope refined by full context.
Independent sustain/control protection retained; lower open ties and middle star-Ped pair now explicit, full ties not equated to necessarily manual holding.
sus. naming concern retained and extended to duration-line/vertical-order/glyph conventions; mere two-level release display is not proof of fully resolved pedal identity.

judgments.decision: retain distinct metre, fermata, free passage and new-speed entries
judgments.reading_benefit: Keeps waiting, active running and renewed regular pulse distinct.
judgments.alternative_cost: A single equal-seconds spacing or completion-to-normal-bar rule would manufacture timing precision.
judgments.limit: No native ticks or performed duration established.

judgments.location: p2 C / p3 E / p8 O / p9 P-Q
judgments.decision: keep actual pulse units and approximate versus exact speed signs
judgments.reading_benefit: C and E explicitly show quaver=quaver; O is approximately quarter=100, while P and Q use dotted quarters 48 and 76.
judgments.alternative_cost: Copying bare BPM numbers, resetting at system breaks or merging all free/rubato passages changes the reading.
judgments.limit: No complete performed tempo map or publisher source state inferred.

judgments.location: p4 systems2-3 / p6 J / p9 P
judgments.decision: preserve local dynamic, hand and line ownership
judgments.reading_benefit: p/mp and p/pp distinguish concurrent layers; r.h./l.h. brackets identify local hand help without moving the whole voice.
judgments.alternative_cost: Uniform alignment, upper-staff-only melody assumptions or one-hand-per-staff assignment conceals roles.
judgments.limit: PDF cannot recover source voice IDs or complete hand choreography.

judgments.decision: retain useful rest entry information in the moving layer
judgments.reading_benefit: Moving-layer stops remain distinct from slow dyads and lower sustain or activity.
judgments.alternative_cost: Deleting rests simply because another layer supplies pulse weakens late-entry/stop recognition.
judgments.limit: Not a rule to fill every software voice with visible rests.

judgments.location: p8 system3 initial lower chord and following low note
judgments.decision: distinguish three open ties after initial lower chord and one later open tie from upper complete ties
judgments.reading_benefit: Signals continuing resonance while freeing the moving notation from receiving-note clutter; upper full ties preserve sustained pitch relation across the run.
judgments.alternative_cost: All-short ties can lose upper continuation, while filling lower long durations can imply hand occupation and crowd the run.
judgments.limit: Complete ties do not prove manual holding; open ties do not prove a precise captured pitch set. No diamond silent-depression action is indicated in this passage.

judgments.decision: preserve two labels, middle star-Ped pair and final two stars; do not auto-deduplicate or assign each release by row height alone
judgments.reading_benefit: The middle clearing/reactivation marking and final dual release are different visible information.
judgments.alternative_cost: Single pedal state or one final star loses a potentially distinct control; guessed endpoint assignment fabricates action.
judgments.limit: No work-specific legend or source object mapping establishes exact capture, release or middle retake ownership. User S.P. definition from a different score is not imported.

judgments.decision: consider explicit names, independent Sost. Ped. duration line, damper notation and clear vertical ordering only after action is known
judgments.reading_benefit: Reduces sus./sost. confusion and makes overlapping control endpoints easier to associate.
judgments.alternative_cost: More lines and local height can affect O and whole-page budget.
judgments.limit: Unrendered future candidate; not applied to source. Current graphic Ped. reuse and absent Sost. extension are not assumed to be an approved best practice.

judgments.location: p8 O, subsequent a piacere and in tempo 2/4 to common time
judgments.decision: preserve explicit recovery bridge and waiting layer
judgments.reading_benefit: Short 2/4 states recovery while lower whole-bar rest and later common-time layers have different jobs.
judgments.alternative_cost: Removing 2/4 or distributing every sustained accompaniment as pointwise solo alignment changes the reading.
judgments.limit: Textbook instrumental accompaniment analogy is conditional; manual piano durations are not thereby arbitrary. Free wording does not automatically cancel existing metre.

judgments.location: p9 a tempo / ppp sostenuto and final Ped.
judgments.decision: do not convert expressive sostenuto into a pedal command
judgments.reading_benefit: Separates character, dynamic and timed note/rest structure from a later explicit Ped. activation/release.
judgments.alternative_cost: Keyword-to-controller mapping adds an unconfirmed action.
judgments.limit: No exact playback or implied discretionary pedalling established.

judgments.location: p4 systems2-3 / p7 L-M-N / p9 row budget
judgments.decision: retain context-dependent measure capacity and inline section starts
judgments.reading_benefit: p4 has 3 versus 2 bars; p7 L first row 6 versus M/N rows 3 each; p9 first row5, fourth/fifth4 each, final5. Different density, layers and endpoints get room.
judgments.alternative_cost: Fixed four-bar grid or mandatory new line at every rehearsal mark redistributes transitions and page count.
judgments.limit: Counts are visible structural observations, not automatic cast-off targets or a proof of unique optimality.

judgments.location: p6-to7, p7-to8 and p8-to9 page boundaries
judgments.decision: do not infer a free-hand page turn from a rest, sustain or fermata alone
judgments.reading_benefit: Retains continuing N activity and cross-page connections; p8 ending/new P is a possible structural boundary only.
judgments.alternative_cost: Moving page breaks under an unverified hands-free assumption can harm practical performance.
judgments.limit: Binding, duplex order, release choreography, printing and actual turn feasibility unverified.
